package shop

import "errors"

// Cart holds line items.
type Cart struct {
	Items []int
}

// Total sums the cart, skipping negatives, with every branch shape Go has.
func Total(c *Cart, ch chan int, v interface{}) (int, error) {
	sum := 0
	for _, it := range c.Items {
		if it < 0 && sum > 0 {
			continue
		}
		sum += it
	}
	switch {
	case sum > 100:
		sum -= 10
	case sum == 0 || len(c.Items) == 0:
		return 0, errors.New("empty")
	}
	switch v.(type) {
	case string:
		sum++
	}
	select {
	case n := <-ch:
		sum += n
	default:
	}
	return sum, nil
}

func (c *Cart) add(n int) {
	c.Items = append(c.Items, n)
}
